title: Assign lead technician offers only technicians and says when none match
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new staff member for this test, staff member A, on the built-in Parts Manager role, with Time Clock on and Technician off, enrolled at the test location only.
  • Have a new staff member for this test, staff member B, on the built-in Technician role, with Time Clock on and Technician on, enrolled at the test location only, so the list has a technician to compare with.
  • Have a new service work order for this test, work order 1, at the test location, in Approved, led by nobody (no lead), so its card is in Unassigned.
  • Start on Work Orders, Board View, at the test location.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1's card more-actions menu.
  2. Click Assign lead technician.
  3. Type staff member A's first name in the window's search.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The more-actions menu opens.

Step 2:

  • The Assign lead technician window opens and offers staff member B.

Step 3:

  • The window shows the existing message No technicians match “[what you typed]”, with your typed text in place of the brackets.
  • Staff member A is not offered.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Technician Toggle", Confluence 977371146, version 20 (3 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 4 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11788, story SV-11881 (Story 3, Who appears on the technician lists)

  • S3-R4: “The Assign lead technician and Reassign lead technician window (from a card's more-actions menu on Board View or Tech View) offers only people per S3-R1. Searching for anyone else shows the existing No technicians match “[search]” message. A current lead who is not offered per S3-R1 is listed last, cannot be picked, and is labeled "Current · no longer assignable"; searching for their name finds that entry.”
  • S3-N1: “A person with Technician off, or with Time Clock off, gets no Board View column, no Tech View group, and is not offered in the Technician filter or any technician dropdown, unless S3-E1 or S3-E2 applies. A person picked in the Technician filter whose Technician is turned off stays offered and picked while the board still gives them a column or group (S3-E1 or S3-E2). Once it no longer does, they stay picked while Work Orders stays open, until the user unticks them or changes location; if they are the only person picked, the board shows "No work orders match these filters". The next time Work Orders is opened from the menu, or the page is reloaded, they are no longer offered and drop out of the filter, as if never picked. A person picked at another location drops out when the location changes. Their work orders do not move.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Technician Toggle" (https://claude.ai/artifact/1fuPz8Y4xTg7Syq1mfmJ9R), version 1793640819-ff4d, read 2 Nov 2026: page "5 Board View and Tech View", pictures "Reassign lead technician, searching "Oli"" (This build) and "Reassign lead technician, searching "Oli"" (Production today (before))

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • tt-p5-08-after-reassign-lead-technician-searching-oli.png
  • tt-p5-07-before-reassign-lead-technician-searching-oli.png

The design's own words:

  • “No match: "No technicians match "Oli"". Only staff whose Technician toggle is on and whose Time Clock is on are offered.”
  • “Opened from a card's more-actions menu on Board View. Olivia Garrett is offered as a lead.”

The design draws the Reassign lead technician window only; Assign lead technician is not drawn.
